Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly extract the birth year from the IMDb biography page it accessed. Although the page's visible text explicitly stated "Born: February 2, 1873" in the mini-bio section, the agent's subsequent analysis and the Planner's synthesis relied on the conflicting "1876" date found in the JSON-LD metadata (which was likely an error in the page's structured data). By not prioritizing the clear, human-readable text over the potentially erroneous metadata, the agent contributed to the confusion regarding the director's birth year, leading to an incorrect comparison with Fern Andra (born 1893).
